definitions.explanation: The state of being married. Composed of 既 (already) + 婚 (marriage). Used as a noun or pre-noun modifier (既婚の). The opposite is 未婚 (みこん, unmarried).

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{既婚|きこん}だ。

{既婚|きこん}{者|しゃ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{未婚|みこん}→未婚：14933_mikon⟧⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧{満足度|まんぞくど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{比較|ひかく}→比較：03576_hikaku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a survey comparing life satisfaction between married and unmarried people.

examples.japanese: ⟦アンケート→アンケート：03829_ankeeto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{項目|こうもく}→項目：04150_koumoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧「{既婚|きこん}・⟦{未婚|みこん}→未婚：14933_mikon⟧」⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧⟦{選択肢|せんたくし}→選択肢：14418_sentakushi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There was a 'married/unmarried' option on the questionnaire.

notes:
USAGE:
{既婚|きこん} is a formal, written term used on forms, surveys, and in statistical contexts. In everyday conversation, ⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧ (is married) is more natural. The pair {既婚|きこん}/⟦{未婚|みこん}→未婚：14933_mikon⟧ often appears together on official documents.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {既婚|きこん}{者|しゃ} (married person)
- {既婚|きこん}⟦{女性|じょせい}→女性：01617_josei⟧ (married woman)
- {既婚|きこん}⟦{男性|だんせい}→男性：01655_dansei⟧ (married man)
- {既婚|きこん}・⟦{未婚|みこん}→未婚：14933_mikon⟧ (married/unmarried — on forms)
- {既婚|きこん}⟦{率|りつ}→率：03802_ritsu⟧ (marriage rate)
